_about: Messages for sign-up and sign-in. Cognito error codes map to the text people see.

errors.UsernameExistsException: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.InvalidPasswordException: Use at least 8 characters, with a lowercase letter and a number.
errors.InvalidParameterException: Check the email and password and try again.
errors.CodeMismatchException: That code is not right. Check the latest email and try again.
errors.ExpiredCodeException: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.UserNotConfirmedException: Confirm your email first: enter the code we sent you.
errors.LimitExceededException: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.TooManyRequestsException: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.TooManyFailedAttemptsException: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.CodeDeliveryFailureException: We could not send the email. Check the address and try again.

error_default: Something went wrong with your account. Please try again.

messages.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it below to confirm your email.
messages.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to set up your profile.
messages.reset_sent: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a code to reset the password.
messages.password_changed: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
messages.saved: Profile saved. Your plan now opens with your details.
messages.deleted: Your account and saved profile are deleted.
messages.disabled: Accounts are not set up on this site.
